definitions.gloss: progress report; interim report; status update
definitions.explanation: A report on the current status and progress of a project, treatment, investigation, or ongoing matter. Common in business, medical, and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please give us a progress report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧、⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We give a project progress report once a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{手術後|しゅじゅつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The family was relieved after receiving the post-surgery progress report from the doctor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧ (progress, course of events) and ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (report). Used frequently in workplace and medical settings to describe periodic updates on ongoing situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to make a progress report
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a progress report
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}: written progress report
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}: interim progress report

USAGE:
In business, progress reports are a standard part of project management. In medical contexts, doctors provide {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく} to patients and their families about recovery or treatment progress.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}{報告|ほうこく}→中間報告：16653_chuukanhoukoku⟧: interim report — emphasizes being midway through
- ⟦{進捗|しんちょく}{報告|ほうこく}→進捗報告：26881_shinchokuhoukoku⟧: progress report — focuses specifically on how far work has advanced
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}→最終報告：26484_saishuuhoukoku⟧: final report — the concluding report
